dct_description_sm: "Lambert conformal conic projection based on standard parallels 33⁰ and 45⁰."

"The slope zones on this map ... were derived from USGS 1:250,000-scale maps and were generated by a semiautomated photomechanical process which translates distance between adjacent contours into percentage of slope."
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Relief shown by contours and spot heights.

Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "Lambert conformal conic projection based on standard parallels 33⁰ and 45⁰." "1927 North American datum." "The slope zones on this map ... were derived from USGS 1:250,000-scale maps and were generated by a semiautomated photomechanical process which translates distance between adjacent contours into percentage of slope." "Experimental printing." "Base map compiled in 1963." Includes diagr. of "Slope zones." Scale 1:500,000; 1 in. equals approx. 8 miles. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2
